description: One MCP client config to paste ({"mcpServers": …}, as Cursor and other MCP clients read it) for up to 10 listings, and how each one connects. A listing is in the config when its own docs give a hosted server address or a local command. An MCP server whose docs give neither comes with its setup guide, and setupPrompt asks a coding agent to set all of those up. A listing without an MCP server comes with its CLI install command, API address or docs. Also returns a claude mcp add command for each server in the config, for Claude Code, and the /stack link for the listings. Nothing is guessed: every address and command is copied from the vendor's docs, as on the listing's page.

slugs.description: Listing slugs, in the order to list them: 1 to 10, e.g. a stack's items

name: connect_bundle

claudeCode.description: A claude mcp add command for each server in the config

config.description: The MCP client config to paste; null when no listing has an address or command to copy

featured.description: Featured: set only by the maintainer. With no search text, results list featured listings first, then A→Z; with search text, results are ranked by relevance and equal scores keep that featured-first order.

how.description: config: in the config; guide: an MCP server to set up from its guide; other: no MCP server

iconUrl.description: Absolute URL of the listing's 128px PNG icon, served by Agent Switchboard; null when it has none

official.description: Official: a first-party listing, published by the company behind the product under its own domain or GitHub org (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP, not a community build), where that company is a major vendor (publicly traded, a frontier AI lab, or valued around $1B+). It records who publishes the product, not a paid placement, and is separate from Verified.

server.description: Its entry in the config, under its slug

verified.description: Verified: we checked it works — its URLs load and its declared access (API, MCP, CLI or extension) responds. Re-checked monthly; the label drops if it stops working.

notes.description: Named listings that were left out, and why

setupPrompt.description: For a coding agent: set up each MCP server that has only a setup guide

stackUrl.description: These listings as a shared stack on the site

summary.description: How many are in the config, to set up from a guide, and without an MCP server
